---

The HiTOP Society maintains three self-report measures of psychopathology at
different lengths and levels of coverage. Choose the one that fits your study
below, then head to its page to download ready-to-use files or explore the
`hitop` R package tools for scoring and customization.

```{=html}
<div class="row mt-4 hitop-downloads">

  <div class="col-md-4 mb-4">
    <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm">
      <div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">
        <h5 class="card-title">📋 HiTOP Self-Report (SR)</h5>
        <p class="card-text text-muted mb-1">405 items · 76 scales · 17 subscales</p>
        <p class="card-text">The full-length measure, offering the most detailed
        coverage of the HiTOP hierarchy from broad spectra down to narrow
        subscales.</p>
        <div class="d-grid mt-auto">
          <a href="../articles/download-hitopsr.html" class="btn btn-primary">View &amp; download →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="col-md-4 mb-4">
    <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm">
      <div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">
        <h5 class="card-title">📄 HiTOP Brief Report (BR)</h5>
        <p class="card-text text-muted mb-1">45 items · 8 scales</p>
        <p class="card-text">A short screening measure spanning the HiTOP
        hierarchy — six spectra plus the Externalizing superspectrum and a
        general p-factor — ideal when respondent time is limited.</p>
        <div class="d-grid mt-auto">
          <a href="../articles/download-hitopbr.html" class="btn btn-primary">View &amp; download →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="col-md-4 mb-4">
    <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm">
      <div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">
        <h5 class="card-title">🧪 HiTOP Harmful Substance Use (HSUM)</h5>
        <p class="card-text text-muted mb-1">Up to 650 items · 3 assessment stages</p>
        <p class="card-text">A dedicated substance-use module with skip/display
        logic, so most respondents answer only a small subset of items.</p>
        <div class="d-grid mt-auto">
          <a href="../articles/download-hitophsum.html" class="btn btn-primary">View &amp; download →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<h3 class="mt-4 mb-3">From instrument to scores</h3>
<ol class="hitop-steps">
  <li><strong>Choose an instrument</strong> from the cards above. Each instrument's page holds its downloads and links to the package's tools for it.</li>
  <li><strong>Choose a route</strong> on that page: a printable Word form, a <a href="../articles/import-instructions.html">Qualtrics or REDCap import</a>, or, on every page but the HiTOP-HSUM's, an <a href="../articles/online-collection.html">online form</a> opened from a study link.</li>
  <li><strong>Collect responses</strong>. Paper and survey-platform responses arrive as your own data; an online form <a href="../articles/online-collection.html#make-the-study-link">sends each participant's responses</a> to the store named in the study link, or saves them as a file.</li>
  <li><strong>Read and score</strong> the data in R: <a href="../reference/read_form_responses.html"><code>read_form_responses()</code></a> reads an online form's file or table, and the <a href="../articles/hitopsr_scoring.html">HiTOP-SR</a>, <a href="../articles/hitopbr_scoring.html">HiTOP-BR</a> and <a href="../articles/pid5_scoring.html">PID-5</a> tutorials show the scoring functions.</li>
</ol>
```
